# Quality Checklist

☐ Reproduction Steps Verified

☐ Expected Result Defined

☐ Actual Result Documented

☐ Evidence Attached

☐ Root Cause Identified

☐ Fix Verified

☐ Regression Completed

☐ Defect Closed

---

# Governance

Approval authority:

- QA Lead
- Engineering Lead

Critical defects shall require formal verification before release approval.

---

# AI Consumption Notes

AI may assist with:

- Defect summarization
- Root cause hypothesis generation
- Duplicate defect detection
- Regression impact analysis
- Test recommendation generation
- Resolution documentation

AI-generated defect analysis shall be validated by engineering and QA teams before closure.
